sections.title: Objective and ownership
sections.sql: select name,owner,objective from programs where id=$1

sections.title: People and progress
sections.sql: select rep,tasks,achieved,overdue,unverified,due_on,status from ramp_status where program_id=$1 order by rep

sections.title: Milestone evidence
sections.sql: select rep,milestone,verified_value,target,unit,evidence,checked_on from milestone_status where program_id=$1 order by rep,milestone
sections.note: Recorded progress is not proof that the program caused a sales result.

sections.title: Open coaching
sections.sql: select coach,topic,due_on from coaching where rep_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence to discuss
sections.sql: select program,milestone,verified_value,target,unit,due_on from milestone_status where rep_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: Internal draft. Check accuracy with the rep before use.

name: completion-record
title: Program evidence record
for_each: select e.id,r.name||' - '||p.name name from enrolments e join reps r on r.id=e.rep_id join programs p on p.id=e.program_id

sections.title: Verified observations
sections.sql: select milestone,kind,verified_value,target,unit,evidence,checked_on,achieved from milestone_status where enrolment_id=$1 order by milestone
sections.note: An internal record, not a qualification or certification.
